description: (Recommended for NFTs) List NFTs owned by a wallet, including kiosk-stored NFTs. Each row has an object id, `collection_ref` (zero-based index into this page's exact `collection_types`), kiosk and display metadata. `detail: 'full'` adds raw Move contents and valuation evidence. `est_usd` is a heuristic NFT estimate; other valued objects carry `value_usd` and a tier. `value: false` skips valuation. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next page; its absence means the wallet is fully enumerated. Use list_nft_collections for a per-collection summary and wallet total.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from a prior response's `next_cursor`. Omit on first call.

detail.description: 'summary' (default) leaves out raw contents and valuation evidence, counted in `omitted`. 'full' includes both.

market_depth.description: Multiplier for per-collection sale/listing reads (default 1); raise through valuation.market_next_call when market coverage is limited.

max_collections.description: Collection types valued on this page (default 100); raise through valuation.next_call if more are present.

value.description: Estimate each NFT's value from its collection's market (default true). Costs a few requests per collection on the page.

name: list_nfts
title: List NFTs
